editorial.blurb: Same Same is a neighborhood gem in Roscoe Village serving thoughtfully crafted Thai food with house-made curries that balance heat, sweetness, and depth in a candlelit back patio that feels almost cinematic.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on a weekday like Monday to walk in easily; weekends mean a 10-15 minute wait, but it moves quickly—and the quiet, candlelit back patio is perfect for date nights or solo dinners when you want to savor the experience.
signatureDishes: Pork belly fried rice (khao phat muu krob)
